name: code-craft
description: Language-specific code best practices and idioms for Claude Code — complementary to swe-compass (stack-agnostic architecture coach). Two modes: reader (rule + reason + example for a topic) and reviewer (apply rules to user code, flag violations with fixes). Currently ships TypeScript, Rust, and CSS/SASS language references and React, Next.js, React Native + Expo, and Hono framework references.
